newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP sees copper price strength to 1998.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP sees copper price strength to 1998.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday it expected recent strength in copper prices to continue into 1998.

"The fundamentals of the industry we think are a little stronger than we were assessing them to be six or nine months ago and we are hoping rather than predicting that the strength that we've seen in recent weeks will continue at least into the enxt calendar year," BHP managing director John Prescott told reporters.
The company said earlier on Friday that net profit in the year to May 31 fell by 60.8 percent to A$410 million after abnormal items of nearly A$1 billion.
More than half of the abnormal loss, A$550 million, was due to write-downs at the North American copper operations.
BHP is the world's second largest copper producer, trailing the state-owned Codelco group in Chile.
It acquired Magma for US$2.4 billion in January 1996 and is the largest shareholder in the Escondida copper mine in Chile.
